newsitem.title: USA: Universal Display develops organic laser.
newsitem.headline: Universal Display develops organic laser.

text.p: Universal Display Corp in conjunction with Princeton University developed an optically pumped organic laser to be used in technological applications such as fiber-optic communications and CD-ROM drives, the company said.

Universal Display President and Chief Operating Officer Steven Abramson said, "They have the potential to transform not only the estimated $2 billion laser market, which is estimated to grow approxiately 20 percent annually, but also the $35 billion display market for everything from cell phones to laptop computers and larger-screen televisions."
